summary: Follow stui screen inventories without timer or focus reads on supported members

replay.detail: Graph admission and action replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema, projection version or wire frame changes.

compatibility.detail: st3-feed and stui select optional inventory-collections version 1 only with the advertised sixteen-slot collections capacity. Clients, one selected usage period, machines, devices, native sessions and terminal lists share the existing socket with all three conversation slots and the selected terminal. Older daemons retain authorized HTTP reads when a relevant view opens or its period changes, with a Fleet note that these inventories are read, not followed.

downtime.detail: No daemon change is required beyond the already optional inventory support.

manual.detail: Normal stui binary replacement enables the new consumer; existing layout, cache, credential and pairing files remain usable.

recovery.detail: Reconnect reopens authoritative inventory snapshots; screen windows leave after the existing thirty-second grace, while switching usage periods replaces the old slot immediately. Late frames and legacy responses from old connections are discarded. Permanent inventory refusals remain visible without HTTP fallback; retryable server resyncs keep the retained subscription. Partial windows are labeled. The existing protocol heartbeat detection and offline wording remain unchanged, as does the sixty-second local cache write.
